'''Berardesco''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The warrior was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Battle for Sobrik|attack]] on the city's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] by a Republic aligned individual during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]]. Berardesco used two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] in combat and wore [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].<ref name="A Clean Sweep">{{TORcite|type=faction|Bonus|A Clean Sweep|Balmorra}}</ref>
